title: [spec-gap][R-LOADNG-009] ROUTE_REFRESH 60 s refresh-on-use never invoked in any stack
description:
Spec B2.2: ROUTE_REFRESH 60 sec 'Refresh if used within'. Classification: divergent (constant and refresh mechanism implemented; behavior never wired).

Evidence: constants exist (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/routing/loadng.h:74; python/src/lichen/loadng/cache.py:22) and refresh mechanisms exist and are unit-tested (lichen_loadng_cache_refresh lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/loadng.c:340-360; RouteCache.refresh python/src/lichen/loadng/cache.py:119-130, test_refresh_extends_validity python/tests/loadng/test_cache.py:51), but no production code calls refresh on route use — the only .refresh( caller in python/src is the evidence tracker (rpl/address_classification.py:74). Effect: a continuously used LOADng route expires after ROUTE_TIMEOUT 300 s and must be re-discovered.

Suggested placement: invoke cache refresh on route lookup/use in each stack's forwarding path (python RouteCache.lookup caller, C cache_lookup caller in router glue), or amend the appendix if refresh-on-use is informational only.
